content.short: WeFi is a decentralized "deobank" providing under-collateralized lending and non-custodial global payment tools.
content.description: WeFi is a comprehensive decentralized finance platform and "deobank" that offers a suite of advanced financial services, including under-collateralized borrowing and a robust leverage engine. The protocol allows users to open leveraged positions on major assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum with minimal downpayments, enhancing capital efficiency. WeFi also provides on-chain bank accounts integrated with global payment solutions, such as the WeFi Visa card, enabling a seamless transition between decentralized assets and everyday spending, powered by institutional-grade tools.
content.meta: WeFi provides decentralized lending, leverage trading, and global on-chain banking services. Discover WeFi and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers site.
